sources.title: Hugging Face Discloses Autonomous AI Agent Security Breach
sources.snippet: •Hugging Face reports an intrusion by an autonomous AI agent system affecting internal datasets and credentials. •The attack exploited code-execution paths in dataset processing to run thousands of actions via a swarm of sandboxes. •Defenders utilized an open-weight model, GLM 5.2, for forensic analysis after commercial API guardrails blocked investigations.
